articles.title: Patch Tuesday, May 2026 Edition
articles.summary: CISA contractor casually drops AWS GovCloud keys on GitHub like breadcrumbs for the digital raccoons. The agency that's supposed to protect everyone's cybersecurity just leaked their own crown jewels to the public internet.

articles.title: MFA Prompt Bombing: Why Your Second Factor Isn't Saving You
articles.summary: Microsoft patches SharePoint RCE with an 8.8 CVSS score that requires zero special conditions to exploit. Because apparently SharePoint wasn't already cursed enough.

articles.title: ⚡ Weekly Recap: Linux Flaws, Defender 0-Days, Router Botnets, and Supply Chain Chaos
articles.summary: Trend Micro's Apex One gets pwned by a zero-day in the wild, proving even security software needs security software. CISA already threw it on the KEV pile of shame.

articles.title: Google blocked the first known AI-powered attack on 2FA accounts; here is how hackers tried to break in, know how to stay safe
articles.summary: Zero-click WhatsApp takeover hits iOS 16 users with no warnings, no linked devices, just pure digital possession. Your phone starts texting people without you—it's like being haunted but with worse privacy implications.

articles.title: Who is TeamPCP, the rising hacker group targeting open-source software and AI tools?
articles.summary: TeamPCP supply chain campaign goes full chaos mode, hitting three package ecosystems simultaneously and even trojanizing Microsoft's own Python SDK. These aren't script kiddies—they're running a professional ransomware franchise.

articles.title: We Updated Our Privacy Policy. Here's What Changed and Why.
articles.summary: Meta plans to launch facial recognition in smart glasses while civil rights groups are 'distracted by other concerns'—because surveillance capitalism never sleeps. Your privacy is just another quarterly earnings optimization.

articles.title: The Hackers Behind Shai-Hulud: Lucky or Skilled?
articles.summary: EFF drops a field guide for fighting digital surveillance abuses across the Americas because apparently we need instruction manuals for basic human rights now. Systematic violations require systematic resistance.

articles.title: MuddyWater Uses DLL Side-Loading in Espionage Campaign Targeting 9 Countries
articles.summary: Russian-speaking hacker jailbreaks Google's Gemini AI and uses it to pump-and-dump crypto from MAGA victims' wallets. When artificial intelligence meets artificial patriotism, everyone gets artificially broke.

articles.title: Zero-Click WhatsApp Account Takeover Hits iPhone Users Running iOS 16. No Linked Devices, No Warning
articles.summary: AI transforms bug hunting into an arms race where both attackers and defenders are wielding silicon-powered vulnerability scanners. The era of humans manually reading assembly dumps is officially dead—long live our robot security overlords.
